title: Gold Dragon, Frost Troll and Ogre
features: Gold-scaled mature dragon retains four grounded legs, two dorsal wings and a rooted tail; wings fold for walking and unfold on jaw strikes.
Pale slate-blue Frost Troll and broad taupe Ogre share the approved giant scale, joined empty-hand strikes, fixed short hair and rope-bound hipwraps.
Boulder windups grip the stone; release hands are empty as the existing projectile leaves. Distinct chest/throat roar gestures remain grounded.
conceptNote: Scenario supplied the three-creature concept sheet. Its raised Gold Dragon gesture is excluded: production retains four grounded legs from the approved Red Dragon anatomy. OpenAI authored all complete pixel figures.
actionsNote: Eight facings per creature. Gold Dragon has eight unique actions; each giant has seven, with existing generic casting aliases sharing its roar gesture.
cadenceNote: Dragon Jaws contacts at .5 s through 1 s; Breath and Presence at .5 s through 1.2 s, and Wingbeat at .7 s through 1.4 s. Giant strikes/roars contact at .4 s through .8 s; boulders release at .4 s and hit after their flight. Rules, effects, stats and placements remain unchanged.
replayNote: The replay contains three movement round trips, three natural strikes, all seven existing specials and return to ready.
contactLabel: ten natural strike, boulder release and special reviews
reviewNotes: Fresh Gold rear-left damage, east walking and northwest Wingbeat figures correct orientation, unwanted walking attacks and overlapping source gutters.
The rejected Ogre throw sheet retained a carried stone at release; a fresh complete sheet shows empty release palms in every facing.
Frenzy Roar FX now waits for the authored .4 s chest gesture across the Troll family; its full .8 s recovery plays without changing gameplay.
The gallery uses lossless compass strips and one-facing phone decoding; original runtime/source pixels are preserved.
Fresh northeast and southeast jaw sequences visibly unfurl both wings; all eight contact silhouettes are checked against the folded idle.
